title: Temple of the Moon
visualBrief: Standing Temple of the Moon heritage compound: mapped red double-eaved green-roofed bell tower with real ground arch and recessed upper lattice, mapped triple-arched roofed park gate with open center/closed side leaves, and mapped west hall with swept green roof/red lattice doors. Include approximate surviving gray inner enclosure/three blocked pale Lingxing portals and short mapped northern outer-wall runs. Original simplified painted-beam/ridge/finial vocabulary, no copied text/photo atlas. Do not reconstruct the no-longer-intact altar. Modern lattice transmission mast and southern park landscaping/pavilions remain host context, not part of this heritage-building model.
